description: This file defines the Controller class within the WPEFramework plugin namespace. It declares a complex class that implements multiple interfaces related to plugin management, web handling, JSON-RPC, system configuration, discovery, and lifecycle management. The class includes nested classes for subsystem data, configuration, and notification handling, and provides method declarations for plugin initialization, deinitialization, web request processing, and control operations such as activate, deactivate, reboot, and status reporting.

classes.name: SubsystemsData
classes.description: A JSON container class representing subsystem data with fields for subsystem type and active status.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Main class implementing plugin, web, JSON-RPC, configuration, discovery, and lifecycle interfaces for plugin control and management.

classes.name: Controller::Sink
classes.description: Notification handler class for plugin and subsystem events, dispatching subsystem updates.

classes.name: Controller::Config
classes.description: Configuration class containing probe settings, resume list, subsystem list, and UI flag.

classes.name: Controller::Config::ProbeConfig
classes.description: Nested class for probe configuration parameters such as TTL and node address.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service context.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns metadata information about the plugin.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming web requests, attaching deserializable data objects.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes web requests and generates responses.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles delete operations on plugin resources.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Clones a plugin with a new callsign.

methods.name: StartDiscovery
methods.description: Starts discovery process with specified TTL.

methods.name: Hibernate
